results.name: A dated midyear snapshot excludes sequential boundary phases and unknown dates
Every paint and selection layer uses the dated regional filter
Traditional labels convert to Simplified Chinese and bilingual names keep the original English
Source links preserve relation versus way identity and reject invalid IDs
Interior label anchor stays outside a polygon hole
World, disabled, hidden borders and modern reference do not fetch regional tiles
Actual regional records switch both fill and stroke, empty views restore original data
Year changes reject stale features and preserve the raw source geometry
Failed source restores overview, hides partial tiles, retries and removes listeners
Turning off detail or entering modern reference restores the territory overview
